name: acqagent
description: Open-source Claude skills for federal acquisition — FAR research, clause checks, and compliance groundwork.

plugins.name: far-clause-checker
plugins.description: Validates FAR provisions and clauses against the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) and HHS Agency Deviation Matrix. Bundles the 22 April 2026 DAU Provision & Clause Matrix and produces a standalone .docx compliance report. FAR only; no DFARS.
